doc.note: Standalone Dolphin reports game-only geometry to the shared Semu CRT pipeline; bezels.json resolves 4:3 or 16:9 art independently.
doc.default: 480-line systems fill their tube at about 2x, where the royale slot mask aliases; easymode with halation is the default and royale the alternate
doc.gdv: M16 (2026-10-06): Retro Crisis's GDV-NTSC for this console is offered one step away while its Deck GPU time is measured (480-line frames make its NTSC passes 2560 px wide; 3.4 ms against easymode's 0.6 ms on the Mac render host). The default moves to it if it holds the Deck's frame.
